nodes.name: Bin's Apartment
nodes.description: A cheap room, a tired desk, too many bills, and the place where impossible things keep becoming normal.

people.label: Call Leo
people.summary: Leo answers with snack noise and dangerous loyalty.

ops.title: Leo Check-in
ops.text: Leo still thinks food solves most impossible problems. He is not entirely wrong.

actions.label: Write private recap
actions.summary: Add a short global journal note about keeping two lives straight.

ops.title: Two Lives, One Calendar
ops.text: Bin is trying to keep classes, delivery shifts, Lily, Haven, and cosmic nonsense from colliding in public.

nodes.name: Zhonghai University
nodes.description: Campus paths, cafeteria noise, and the special kind of pressure caused by seeing someone you like near vending machines.

people.label: Find Luna
people.summary: Luna notices Bin is different and refuses to make it easy for either of them.

ops.title: Luna Noticed
ops.text: Luna did not ask where Bin went. She asked why his answers got quieter.

people.label: Talk with Meilin
people.summary: Meilin sees through the joke before Bin finishes building it.

ops.title: Meilin's Look
ops.text: Meilin did not say he was lying. That was worse. She just looked like she was waiting for the truth to get tired.

nodes.name: Municipal Hospital
nodes.description: Ward lights, plastic chairs, quiet courage, and Lily pretending not to count every visit.

people.label: Visit Lily
people.summary: A normal visit that matters more than a boss fight.

ops.title: Lily Visit Logged
ops.summary: Bin made time for Lily after returning from another world.

ops.title: Lily Visit
ops.text: Lily asked if he was eating. Bin lied. Lily noticed. The room still felt warmer afterward.

nodes.name: Old Zhou's Bookstore
nodes.description: Old paper, wuxia shelves, and the uncomfortable feeling that some childhood notebooks were not imagination.

ops.title: Old Notebook Seen
ops.summary: Bin reread drawings that may be Haven memories.

ops.title: Old Notebook
ops.text: Frozen trees, a guild stamp, a half-orc archer, an armored girl on an ice cliff. The notebook is starting to look less like fiction.

nodes.name: Evening Delivery Route
nodes.description: Scooter lights, bad elevators, worse tips, and the fastest way for normal life to ambush Bin.

actions.label: Run delivery shift
actions.summary: Earn money and risk Earth Heat.

ops.text: Bin survived one more delivery shift and one elevator that smelled like regret.
